title: How to get the schematic or world folder?
summary: A guide on how to get the schematic or the world folder.

body.content: This is a guide on how to get and download the schematic and/or world folder from the website or from discord.

First you have to remember the [DN](https://wiki-theysix.ro-mihaiu.xyz/w/discord/what-is-download-number) or the [video link](https://wiki-theysix.ro-mihaiu.xyz/w/discord/where-can-i-find-the-video-link).

items.content: Select the file you want, Schematic or World. And click on the provided link.
If there is not a schematic provided, go in [#'Top Schematics wanted'](https://discord.com/channels/985227944236568606/1559976502647590953) and make a request by entering the DN in the post.
But if you found it, congrats. Click on the mediafire.com link and download it in your ~/Downloads or C:\Users\%username%\Downloads.

body.content: If you have the DN, open [theysix.ro-mihaiu.xyz](https://theysix.ro-mihaiu.xyz) and search by DN or by farm type / video name. For example, open https://theysix.ro-mihaiu.xyz/dn/467.

items.content: Open the DN link in your browser.
Choose the schematic or world folder you want.
Save the file in your ~/Downloads or C:\Users\%username%\Downloads folder.

body.content: If you don't know how to use the schematic or world folder, check out [How to use a world folder](https://wiki-theysix.ro-mihaiu.xyz/w/how-to-use-a-world-folder) and [How to use a litematica file and add it in Minecraft Java](https://wiki-theysix.ro-mihaiu.xyz/w/how-to-use-a-litematica-file-and-add-it-in-minecraft-java).
